notes.name: dual_rail.md
notes.text:
Dual-rail LM358 GUI task:
- Saved /home/cua/kicad_project/dual_rail/dual_rail.kicad_sch; step 49 title had no star and status confirmed saved.
- Place all units in chooser places LM358 A, B, then C sharing U1. Mirroring A with y gave inverting input above non-inverting; B inherited orientation; y on C restored V+ above V-.
- power:+15V and power:-15V searches worked. y flips negative supply arrow down before placement. Power symbols placed directly on supply pin endpoints removed open circles.
- Explicit resistor references R1, R3, R2 were set in properties. Ctrl+D assigned the available R2 after R3 existed.
- Home then two F1 actions gave useful Z3 view. Earlier scroll attempts caused extreme zoom; prefer keyboard zoom with inspection.
- Visual review matched committed design; no evaluator score exists yet. Prior infrared task scored only 0.33, so its apparent success does not establish netlist correctness or identify which comparison passed.
